instruction: A cinematic wide shot of a minimalist dance studio with a dark wall and wooden floor. In the foreground center-left, the bearded man in the brown shirt (R1) kneels on all fours with his head bowed. In the center, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) performs a headstand, extending one leg straight up and the other horizontally to the right. On the far left, the clean-shaven man in the brown shirt (R3) is kneeling on all fours, while on the far right, the woman in the yellow shirt with a ponytail (R4) holds a back-bending headstand. In the background, two other dancers in matching attire kneel in similar poses. A warm spotlight from the right casts a bright flare across the moody, low-key scene.
elements: R2 performs a headstand while R1 kneels on all fours
R4 holds a back-bending headstand while R3 kneels on all fours
